stations.name: Lemonbay Halt
stations.greeting: Ah, Wren's old train! Come, the damsels have been waiting for you.

stations.name: Santa Brezza
stations.greeting: Mind the wet steps, friend. The anemones like a slow hello.

stations.name: Marisol Cove
stations.greeting: Orange and white, bright as a parasol. Clownfish, fresh from the cove!

stations.name: Capo Mangrovia
stations.greeting: Watch your shoes. The mudskippers here jump before they think.

stations.name: Pescadoro Pier
stations.greeting: Hear that snap? That's the shrimp saying welcome.

stations.name: Gabbiano Lighthouse
stations.greeting: End of the Sunny Coast, they say. The lamp has always pointed further.

stations.name: Grimsvik Quay
stations.greeting: Cold hands, warm cocoa, golden garibaldi. You're welcome in Grimsvik.

stations.name: Tangholm
stations.greeting: The kelp grows tall here, and the seahorses hold on tight.

stations.name: Selnes Light
stations.greeting: Look closely. Our seadragons dress up as seaweed for visitors.

stations.name: Ravnfjord
stations.greeting: A whole cloud of krill in one jar. Don't count them, you'll be here all winter.

stations.name: Isbrekka
stations.greeting: Icefish have clear blood, you know. Clear hearts too, I think.

stations.name: Kaldhavn Harbour
stations.greeting: Last stop of the fjords. Wren once said the smoke to the south was calling her.

stations.name: Kahiko Landing
stations.greeting: Aloha, little train! Warm sand, warm water, warm vents below.

stations.name: Pumice Point
stations.greeting: Stones that float, crabs with fur. Strange shore, good shore.

stations.name: Ember Bay
stations.greeting: Our snails wear iron shoes. Very fashionable, very sturdy.

stations.name: Motu Ahi
stations.greeting: The octopus will try to ride your train. Let her, she's earned it.

stations.name: Obsidian Reach
stations.greeting: Quiet now. The ghost rays only come when the glass is calm.

stations.name: Grand Terminus
stations.greeting: You came all this way. Wren said you would.
